title: Fix POSIX installed CLI symlink entrypoint
description: PR 30 CI shows npm global install smoke invokes prefix/bin/loreweaver on Linux and exits 0 with no output. Root cause: npm creates a POSIX bin symlink, but the CLI entrypoint guard compares import.meta.url to process.argv[1] without resolving symlinks, so main() is skipped. Expected: installed loreweaver command runs main() and reports first-run config guidance when config env is missing.
notes:
Evidence: gh run view 26265719687 --log-failed showed npm run smoke:cli-install failing in CI at scripts/smoke-cli-install.mjs:43: expected installed loreweaver without config to exit 1, got 0, with no stdout/stderr. CI is Ubuntu Node 22, while local Windows smoke passed.
Root cause: POSIX npm global install exposes bin as prefix/bin/loreweaver symlink to @loreweaver/cli/dist/index.js. index.ts guarded main() with import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href, so symlink invocation uses argv[1]=prefix/bin/loreweaver and fails to match the real module URL. main() is skipped and Node exits 0.
Verification: npm run typecheck -> exit 0; npm run test -> exit 0 with 36 files passed / 1 skipped and 229 tests passed / 2 skipped on Windows (new POSIX symlink regression skipped locally); npm run smoke:cli-install -> exit 0. CI will verify the POSIX symlink path.
close_reason: Resolved POSIX npm-bin symlink entrypoint by realpath-resolving process.argv[1] before the import.meta.url guard; added POSIX symlink regression test. Verification: npm run typecheck, npm run test, and npm run smoke:cli-install passed locally; PR CI will verify Linux path.
